description: mod-organizations configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-organizations revision 14, image 2.2.0); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file. mod-organizations is a stateless RMB business-logic module in front of mod-organizations-storage: it has no database, no Kafka and no secret store, so it reads only JVM options and logging configuration from the environment. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-organizations container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-organizations container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-organizations container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; together with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves only about 128 MiB of the container for non-heap memory, so lower it if the container limit is reduced

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Threshold for the first metaspace garbage collection (not a limit). Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: mod-organizations is stateless: every request is translated into calls to mod-organizations-storage and acquisitions units within that request, so replicas can run side by side without coordination.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for single-record CRUD and paged searches over organizations.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options read by the run-java.sh entrypoint of the folioci base image (heap sizing from the java block; -Dhttp.port overrides the default port 8081, which must match the sidecar's MODULE_URL)

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location of an external Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties; the bundled log4j2-json.properties can be selected for JSON logs

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier; must match the other modules and sidecars of the deployment

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the sidecar process: the java block sizing plus -Dquarkus.http.host=0.0.0.0 and -Djava.util.logging.manager=org.jboss.logmanager.LogManager, as on bugfest

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-organizations container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-organizations module deployed alongside this sidecar
